bosses.name: Magmadar
bosses.cite: boss_magmadar.cpp:49-50 LAVA_BOMB 19411 / 20474 on a random raider; :34,56 FRENZY 19451 triggers LAVA_BREATH 19272, a 35 yd cone, twice per frenzy

blockedBy.position: no ROW is owed here, and the old reason is stale. This used to say behind_target walks a ranged raider ~60 yd (back = max(MELEE_REACH_YD, cur)) and RUNOUT_YIELD_AFTER_MS abandons it at 4 s. E5.3 changed that: past MELEE_REACH_YD + MELEE_PARK_SLACK_YD the move now rotates to coneClearBandRad's nearest clear bearing at the mover's OWN radius (sessionMechanicMove.ts:385-393), which is an arc step, not a diameter. coneArcsOfKit reads the KIT rather than the cast bar, and 19272 Lava Breath is aoeShape cone radiusYd 35 with no coneDeg so it takes the 60 deg default; Magmadar carries it on charmSpells, which combatEnemySpec.ts:93-94 merges into spec.spells, so the arc is visible. Measured instead of asserted: capability frenzyCone has Frenzy 19451 landing 9x and Lava Breath sweeping 6x over 800 ticks with the ranged raider clear of 6 of 6 - the motion layer already answers this fight's position ask, so a row would be a second answer to a solved question. The 31-vs-33 deaths measurement the old text quoted was taken against the pre-E5.3 move and no longer describes the tree. Left in kinds and in blockedBy because no ROW delivers it, which is what this field records.
